channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-10-30 — crisis
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 287¢/lb — down 6.6% on the week and down 0.4% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 33 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (-0.0σ). The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is low. A weakening Brazilian real (+4.0% in a month) raises producers' local-currency revenue per bag — added selling pressure.
